messages.subject: Project Marlin - Series B term sheet
messages.plaintextBody:
Nadia,

Great to meet last week. Attached is our proposed Series B term sheet: £18m at a £62m pre-money, with Westbridge leading at £15m. Key points are the 1x non-participating preference, broad-based weighted average anti-dilution, one Westbridge board seat and the usual consent matters. Costs cap on our side at £45k.

We'd like to sign and move to exclusivity this week if the headline terms work for you. Sarah's team can pick up the long-form docs.

Best,
Rosalind

messages.plaintextBody:
Rosalind,

Thanks - the headline terms look workable. Two things from our side: we'd want the option pool sized so it doesn't over-dilute the founders, and we'd like the founder warranty cap kept to our proceeds. Sarah will revert on the detail but I'm happy to sign the term sheet and start the 8-week exclusivity.

Nadia
